constraints: derive from historical rookie outcomes before consulting market residuals
do not infer an exact slot for future picks whose order is unknown
validate against independent market/trade evidence before production
items.description: When exact rookie draft order/slot is known, replace broad early/mid/late bucketing with a monotone slot-level value curve (for example 1.01, 1.02, ...), while retaining early/mid/late for genuinely unknown future picks.
